author: Turkey Tom
description:
4Chan has been one of the internet's most controversial sites for almost as long as it's existed. From radical political ideologies to unorthodox urges, the site's userbase has been using it's anonymity to share anything and everything for over a decade, resulting in it's less-than-stellar reputation. However, a few specific users have actually committed crimes and posted about them to the boards, whether they be killings of passion, or pure psychopathic rage. In this video I go over some of the lesser-known examples - I did my best to avoid well known mass-casualty perpretrators since those have already been covered to death.
